title: INTERVIEW-3: Feed the interview profile into the build prompt and seed repo
body:
**Owner:** Product manager
**Trigger:** see below
**Done check:** grep:site/worker.js::profileBrief
**Status:** closed

aiHtml and the seed IDEA.md generator should read profile:<id> (who, money, depth) instead of only the sentence. Trigger: INTERVIEW-1 live. Closing probe: a build for a profile with money=Y contains a pricing or checkout element.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 221.7 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
